content.title: Cloudflare surges as viral AI agent buzz lifts expectations
content.summary: Cloudflare shares surged about 14% premarket on Tuesday as social media buzz around the "Clawdbot" ​AI agent rekindled investor enthusiasm for the company's tools ‌that help run the technology.  Developers building with Clawdbot, which is based on ‌Anthropic's Claude, use Cloudflare's low-latency infrastructure to securely connect with the agent and run it locally on devices, enabling autonomous task execution.  Cloudflare's globally distributed edge network and consumption-based pricing ​model position it to benefit as AI agents scale ‌up.
